page.notes: Two-column summary: the left column reads "1 Tigranem Armenium ... Syri regem sibi deligunt" and "2 Victo Tigrane, Antiochia ..."; the right column's second line is cut off at the end of this part. Printed text is continued on the other half of the page. Marginal numerals 10 and 15 and the § mark are reference marks; the "rexSyriæ,quæ postea in pro" line is a single run in the printed right-hand column. The first word is a large woodcut initial M, read as the initial of "MVTVIS"; the marginal note at the left ("Syria bellis fraternis & civilibus consumpta, externum regem, nempe Tigranem Armenium sibi deligit") is in the left margin, and line numbers 20, 25, 30 stand in the right margin. The first line may be partly from the initial and is uncertain.
